claims.claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN extends Faster R-CNN by adding a branch for predicting an object mask in parallel with the existing branch for bounding box recognition.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The method, called Mask R-CNN, extends Faster R-CNN by adding a branch for predicting an object mask in parallel with the existing branch for bounding box recognition.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN is simple to train and adds only a small overhead to Faster R-CNN, running at 5 fps.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Mask R-CNN is simple to train and adds only a small overhead to Faster R-CNN, running at 5 fps.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Without bells and whistles, Mask R-CNN outperforms all existing, single-model entries on every task, including the COCO 2016 challenge winners.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Without bells and whistles, Mask R-CNN outperforms all existing, single-model entries on every task, including the COCO 2016 challenge winners.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The proposed RoIAlign layer improves mask accuracy by relative 10% to 50%, showing bigger gains under stricter localization metrics.
claims.evidence_quote_short: RoIAlign has a large impact: it improves mask accuracy by relative 10% to 50%, showing bigger gains under stricter localization metrics.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Decoupling mask and class prediction by predicting a binary mask for each class independently is essential for good instance segmentation results.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we found it essential to decouple mask and class prediction: we predict a binary mask for each class independently, without competition among classes

claims.claim_text_normalized: Using a per-pixel softmax and a multinomial loss couples mask and class prediction and results in a severe loss in mask AP of 5.5 points.
claims.evidence_quote_short: This alternative couples the tasks of mask and class prediction, and results in a severe loss in mask AP (5.5 points).

claims.claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN can be extended to human pose estimation by viewing each keypoint as a one-hot binary mask with minimal modification.
claims.evidence_quote_short: By viewing each keypoint as a one-hot binary mask, with minimal modification Mask R-CNN can be applied to detect instance-specific poses.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN surpasses the winner of the 2016 COCO keypoint competition and runs at 5 fps.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Mask R-CNN surpasses the winner of the 2016 COCO keypoint competition, and at the same time runs at 5 fps.
